title: 我的家
intro: A child's first words are people: 妈妈, 爸爸, then everyone around the dinner table. Chinese names relatives precisely (father's side vs mother's side, older vs younger). You'll also meet the first sentence patterns: A 是 B, 我叫…, 有/没有, and yes/no questions with 吗.

items.note: Sounds exactly like 他. The 女 radical marks 'she' in writing only.

ex.p: wǒ men shì yī jiā rén
wǒ men dōu ài nǎi nai

items.note: Links two nouns: A 是 B. Never before a plain adjective (我很好, not 我是好).

ex.p: tā bù shì wǒ dì di

items.note: Negates verbs and adjectives. Becomes bú before a 4th tone. 有 takes 没 instead.

ex.p: nǐ jiào shén me míng zi
mā ma jiào wǒ bǎo bao
nǐ jiào shén me míng zi
wǒ de míng zi jiào xiǎo hóng

items.note: A question word replaces the thing you ask about, in the same place: 这是什么？
In plain statements an adjective needs 很: 我很好. Unstressed 很 barely means 'very'.

ex.en: My little brother is very small.

ex.p: wǒ jiā yǒu sì gè rén
ex.en: There are four people in my family.

ex.zh: 爷爷奶奶都是我的家人。
ex.p: yé ye nǎi nai dōu shì wǒ de jiā rén
ex.en: Grandpa and Grandma are my family too.

ex.p: wǒ ài wǒ de jiā rén

items.note: Formal and written: 父亲 fù qīn.

ex.p: bà ba jiào wǒ xiǎo míng

items.note: Formal and written: 母亲 mǔ qīn.

ex.p: wǒ yǒu yī gè gē ge

ex.en: My older brother is ten now.
My older sister is called Xiaohong.
I don't have an older sister.

ex.p: dì di shì gè bǎo bao
ex.en: My little brother is a baby.

ex.p: wǒ yǒu liǎng gè dì di

ex.en: My little sister is very small.
Do you have a younger sister?

ex.p: yé ye hé nǎi nai lái le
wǒ yé ye qī shí suì

items.note: In the north: 姥爷 lǎo ye. 外 'outside' because traditionally mother's family was 'outside' the household.

ex.p: wài gōng hé wài pó dōu hěn hǎo
ex.en: Grandpa and Grandma (mom's side) are both well.

items.note: In the north: 姥姥 lǎo lao.

items.en: baby; sweetie (what parents call little kids)

ex.p: zhè ge bǎo bao hěn xiǎo
wǒ yǒu yī gè jiě jie
nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ gè rén
ex.en: How many people are in your family?

items.note: The negative of 有 is always 没有, never 不有.

ex.en: I don't have an older brother.

ex.p: wǒ men jiā méi yǒu māo

items.en: (general measure word for people and things)
items.note: Number + measure word + noun: 一个人. Often said in the neutral tone: 这个 zhè ge.

ex.p: wǒ yǒu liǎng gè mèi mei

items.note: 我的书 = my book. With family and close ties it's usually dropped: 我妈妈, 我家.

ex.p: nà shì bà ba de shū
wǒ ài bà ba mā ma
mā ma ài wǒ wǒ yě ài mā ma
ex.en: Mom loves me, and I love Mom too.

items.note: Also pronounced shuí, especially in songs and formal reading.

ex.en: Which one is your older brother?

items.note: Joins nouns and pronouns only, never two sentences.

ex.p: wǒ hé mèi mei dōu ài mā ma
ex.en: My little sister and I both love Mom.

ex.p: yé ye hé nǎi nai zài jiā
ex.en: Grandpa and Grandma are at home.

items.note: Goes right before the verb: 我也爱你 (not 也我爱你).

ex.p: jiě jie ài wǒ gē ge yě ài wǒ
ex.en: My sister loves me, and my brother does too.

items.note: Goes before the verb and refers back to a plural subject.

ex.p: wǒ men dōu shì yī jiā rén
bà ba mā ma dōu ài wǒ
ex.en: Mom and Dad both love me.

items.en: (turns a statement into a yes/no question)
items.note: Statement + 吗 = question. Answer by repeating the verb: 是/不是, 有/没有.

ex.en: Do you have a younger brother?

我.h: A hand 手 holding a dagger-axe 戈: me, ready to defend myself.

他.h: A person 亻 + 也: that other person.

她.h: A woman 女 + 也: she. Invented in the 1910s.

们.h: People 亻 at the door 门: a crowd. Makes pronouns plural.

是.h: The sun 日 above 正 'correct': what's under the sun is so.

名.h: At dusk 夕 nobody can see you, so you call out your name with your mouth 口.

字.h: A child 子 under a roof 宀, learning characters.

么.h: A tiny twist of thread; only used inside words.

很.h: Step 彳 + 艮 for the sound.

家.h: A pig 豕 under a roof 宀: an ancient home kept pigs.

哥.h: 可 stacked on 可: the bigger one on top.

姐.h: Woman 女 + 且 qiě for the sound.

弟.h: A cord wound around a stick in order: the younger one comes after.

妹.h: A girl 女 who is 'not yet' 未 grown up.

爷.h: Father 父 on top: father's father.

奶.h: Woman 女 + 乃 nǎi for the sound. Also 'milk' (牛奶).

外.h: Divining 卜 in the evening 夕 was done outside.

公.h: Splitting 八 what's private 厶: public, fair. In 外公: grandpa.

婆.h: Waves 波 above a woman 女: an old woman, grandma.

宝.h: Jade 玉 under your roof 宀: a treasure. Your baby is your 宝.

有.h: A hand 𠂇 holding a piece of meat 月: to have.

没.h: Sinking under water 氵: gone, not there.

个.h: A person 人 standing by a stick: one single item.

的.h: White 白 + ladle 勺. Also read dí (的确 indeed) and dì (目的 aim).

爱.h: A hand 爫 over a cover 冖 protecting a friend 友. Traditional 愛 has a heart 心 in it.

谁.h: Speech 讠 + a bird 隹: 'who's that chirping?'

这.h: Walk 辶 over to the writing 文 right here: this.

那.h: A town 阝 over there: that.

和.h: Grain 禾 for every mouth 口: harmony; and.

也.h: Once a picture of a snake; borrowed for 'also'.

都.h: Everyone 者 in the city 阝: all. Also dū, capital (首都).

吗.h: A mouth 口 + 马 for the sound: the question 'ma?'.

texts.title: 拉大锯

lines.p: lā dà jù chě dà jù
lines.en: Pull the big saw, drag the big saw,

lines.p: lǎo lao jiā mén kǒu chàng dà xì
lines.en: at Granny's gate there's a big opera.

lines.p: jiē guī nü qǐng nǚ xu
lines.en: They fetch the daughter, invite the son-in-law,

lines.p: xiǎo wài sūn yě yào qù
lines.en: and the little grandson wants to go too.

notes: Grandparents sit facing the child, hold hands and rock back and forth 'sawing' while chanting.
姥姥 lǎo lao = 外婆 in northern speech. 闺女 guī nü = daughter (northern, spoken). 女婿 nǚ xu = son-in-law. 外孙 = daughter's son.

texts.title: 我的家
texts.src: original picture story for this app

lines.zh: 这是我爸爸，那是我妈妈。
lines.p: zhè shì wǒ bà ba nà shì wǒ mā ma
lines.en: This is my dad, and that's my mom.

lines.zh: 我有一个姐姐，没有哥哥。
lines.p: wǒ yǒu yī gè jiě jie méi yǒu gē ge
lines.en: I have an older sister, but no older brother.

lines.p: jiě jie jiào xiǎo hóng tā hěn ài wǒ
lines.en: My sister is called Xiaohong. She loves me a lot.
I love her a lot too.

lines.zh: 爷爷、奶奶、外公、外婆也是我的家人。
lines.p: yé ye nǎi nai wài gōng wài pó yě shì wǒ de jiā rén
lines.en: Grandpa, Grandma and Mom's parents are my family too.

notes: 小明 and 小红 are the 'Tom and Jane' of Chinese textbooks.
我爸爸, 我妈妈: no 的 needed with close family.

exercises.why: A 是 B: this is my dad.
有 is always negated with 没: 没有. 不有 doesn't exist.
A question word already makes the question. Don't add 吗.
No 是 before adjectives: 我很好.
和 joins two nouns: 爸爸和妈妈.
也 (also) goes right before the verb.

exercises.p: wǒ yǒu yī gè jiě jie
yé ye hé nǎi nai dōu ài wǒ
exercises.en: Grandpa and Grandma both love me.

exercises.p: nǐ jiào shén me míng zi
wǒ yǒu yī gè gē ge
wǒ men shì yī jiā rén

scenario.title: 奶奶来了
scenario.setting: Grandma arrives for a visit and quizzes you, as grandmas do.

a.p: bǎo bao nǐ zhī dao wǒ shì shéi ma
a.en: Sweetie, do you know who I am?

opts.fb: 爷爷 is grandpa. She's 奶奶.

a2.p: wǒ bù shì yé ye wǒ shì nǎi nai

opts.fb: Children greet elders with title + 好.

b.p: zhēn guāi nǐ jiào shén me míng zi

opts.fb: Needs a verb: 我叫小明 / 我的名字叫小明.

c.p: nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ gè rén
c.en: How many people are in your family?

opts.zh: 我家有四个人：爸爸、妈妈、姐姐和我。
opts.p: wǒ jiā yǒu sì gè rén bà ba mā ma jiě jie hé wǒ
opts.en: Four: Dad, Mom, my sister and me.

opts.p: wǒ jiā shì sì gè rén
opts.fb: Use 有 for 'there are': 我家有四个人.

d.p: nǐ ài nǐ de jiě jie ma
d.en: Do you love your big sister?

opts.en: Yes! I love her a lot.

opts.fb: Repeat the verb: 爱 / 不爱.

e.p: hǎo hái zi nǎi nai yě ài nǐ
e.en: Good child! Grandma loves you too.
